findings.description: Inocente Lopez (L8GW-R6Y) died in September 1916 in the jurisdiction of Suchitoto, Cuscatlán, El Salvador. The records disagree on the day, and no record examined settles it. The dates the indexes give as his death date are: 20 September 1916, from the index of a Suchitoto church death record (burial 21 September 1916); 22 September 1916, from the civil registration index; and 23 September 1916, from a second civil index of the same death. Any one of 20, 21, 22 or 23 September 1916 as a single day, or September 1916 at month precision, satisfies this. 21 September 1916 is accepted although no index gives it as his death date; the church index gives it as his burial date. A year-only 1916, a range reaching outside September 1916, or any 1906 date does not.

details.date: Unresolved within September 1916. Indexed death dates: 20 September 1916 (church index; burial 21 September 1916), 22 September 1916 (civil registration index), 23 September 1916 (second civil index). Accepted: 20, 21, 22 or 23 September 1916 as a single day, or September 1916.

That Suchitoto death entry (the FamilySearch hint) is an infant: the register states the deceased was eighteen days old, the illegitimate son of Santos López, and died of influenza in the Valle del Zapote. L8GW-R6Y was a married man whose children were born 1884-1895 and who died in 1916.
